title: Silent Auction of Award-Winning Watercolor Artist Larry Folding
bodyHtml:
Michael Rudden August 25, 2026

‘Art for Good’ Silent Auction – Monday, August 31, 2026 – Harwich Port, MA

 The Guild of Harwich Artists will be holding a silent auction on August 31, from 11am to 3pm at Doane Park in Harwich Port. Over twenty-five original framed and matted watercolor paintings by award-winning artist Larry Folding will be sold to the highest bidders. Bids will be accepted between 11am and 3pm at which time the highest bidders will be notified by cell phone for painting pickup. Alternative pickup options are available.

Larry is a member of the Guild of Harwich Artists, a signature member of the New England Watercolor Society, Cape Cod Arts Center, associate member of American Watercolor Society and the National Watercolor Society. His numerous awards include:

  • Second Place, Cape Cod Arts Center, Fall National 2024
  • Best in Show: Gold Award, NEWS Signature Members Show 2023
  • Award of Merit, NEWS Signature Member Show 2022
  • Honorable Mention, CCAC National Exhibit 2021
  • Best in Show, Chatham Creative Arts Center 2019

This is a one-time opportunity for you to take home an original watercolor painting by a beloved local artist who has helped so many artists learn the skills and joys of watercolor painting. Part of the proceeds will benefit the Harwich Family Pantry. Larry will be on hand to greet you!
